simple.meaning: שֹׁמַע (shômaʻ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a report.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Joshua 6:27. The surrounding context includes kingship, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֹׁמַע (H8089) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שֹׁמַע (shômaʻ) / H8089 is traced through Joshua 6:27, Joshua 9:9, Esther 9:4, Jeremiah 6:24 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: So Yahweh was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land.
They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of Yahweh your God; for we have heard of his fame, all that he did in Egypt,
For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces; for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater.
We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.
